files.initialValue: Existing table orders-releases: string partition key service. Item service=orders/orders, desiredRelease=orders-805. Protected coordinator changes desiredRelease only when owner is absent. Only deployment identity claims/completes. All service writers use this coordinator. CI serializes attempts per service, including same-release retries. No TTL on active ownership. Release records are protected approved inputs, not arbitrary user JSON.

checklist: Retry reuses the candidate without building or registering another task definition.
Superseded desired releases and unexpected service revisions are rejected.
Failure retains the claim; success records completion.
